title: Panicked caller who corrects the floor, side and victim location

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Fire! There's a fire at 8866 Gulf Freeway, the office building!

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Second floor, no, no, sorry, it's the first floor.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: The smoke is coming from the back of the building.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Wait, actually no, the flames are on the east side, I can see them through the windows.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes! My manager is still in there, in the kitchen I think.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: No wait, sorry, he went back to his office, the corner office on the east side.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: And the clinic on our floor keeps oxygen tanks.
